acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Kirk Johnson tells Ira about a strange choice he made during his family’s evacuation from the Sunset Fire in Los Angeles.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Editor Nancy Updike tries to make sense of this current moment by talking to a master of dark comedy, Armando Ianucci.
acts.title: Who’s Laughing Now?

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: As President Trump prepares to return to the Oval Office, producer Valerie Kipnis talks to Ukrainian soldiers on the front line who wonder about what his administration could mean for them.
acts.credits: By Valerie Kipnis; Additional reporting by Anastasiia Mozghova
acts.title: The View From the Dugout

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Editor Susan Burton reflects on the ramp-up to an era that comes for so many of us.
acts.title: Period Piece

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc:
In the wake of the Eaton Fire in Altadena, California, producer Miki Meek talks to a woman on a very particular mission.
We first heard about Vanessa's story in the Associated Press.
acts.title: Since You’ve Been Gone
